scripts.install:all: bun install --cwd apps/web && bun install --cwd apps/server
scripts.dev:server: PORT=8080 HOST=127.0.0.1 bun run --cwd apps/server dev
scripts.test: bun run --cwd apps/web test && bun run --cwd apps/server test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/server typecheck
